# `grants_opportunity_observations`

**Grants.gov opportunity and forecast observations**

One observation per source notice in a declared Grants.gov daily XML snapshot, with literal eligibility, deadlines, amounts and source revisions.

**Coverage.** Not a range. Designed to retain every admitted record in each explicitly selected daily snapshot. Full real-export qualification and public delivery are pending. The date records this design statement, not a source measurement. Snapshot membership does not establish active/open status, withdrawal, deletion or historical completeness. *(measured 2026-10-20)*

- **Parquet file:** `grants_opportunity_observations.parquet`
- **MCP `query_sql` support:** Configured; requires an available artifact.
- **Publication status:** Not established by this schema page or its measurement date.
- **Row count:** Not stated here; the MCP `describe_table` reply gives the live count under `publication`.

| Column | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `snapshot_date` | `DATE` | Date in the selected export name/scope, separate from capture time and notice dates. |
| `notice_type` | `VARCHAR` | Explicit synopsis or forecast XML record kind; neither proves current open, posted, closed or withdrawn status. |
| `opportunity_id` | `VARCHAR` | Literal Grants.gov OpportunityID, including leading zeros. |
| `version` | `VARCHAR` | Literal publisher Version such as Synopsis 2 or Forecast 1; absent and empty stay distinct. |
| `opportunity_number` | `VARCHAR` | Publisher opportunity number; separate from OpportunityID. |
| `title` | `VARCHAR` | Publisher title with decoded XML text preserved; no second HTML decoding. |
| `agency_code` | `VARCHAR` | Literal publisher agency code; no inferred cross-agency join. |
| `agency_name` | `VARCHAR` | Literal publisher agency name. |
| `opportunity_category` | `VARCHAR` | Literal publisher opportunity category code. |
| `eligibility_text` | `VARCHAR` | Full AdditionalInformationOnEligibility text; retained even when an eligibility code says unrestricted. |
| `description` | `VARCHAR` | Complete decoded XML Description text, including embedded markup. |
| `close_date_explanation` | `VARCHAR` | Literal synopsis deadline explanation, including non-date conditions. |
| `estimated_synopsis_close_date_explanation` | `VARCHAR` | Literal forecast deadline explanation; not an actual synopsis deadline. |
| `cost_sharing_or_matching_requirement` | `VARCHAR` | Literal publisher cost-sharing or matching field. |
| `eligibility_codes_json` | `VARCHAR` | Ordered JSON array of every EligibleApplicants occurrence; unknown codes remain. |
| `funding_category_codes_json` | `VARCHAR` | Ordered JSON array of every CategoryOfFundingActivity occurrence. |
| `funding_instruments_json` | `VARCHAR` | Ordered JSON array of every FundingInstrumentType occurrence; no inferred code labels. |
| `assistance_listing_numbers_json` | `VARCHAR` | Ordered JSON array of every literal CFDANumbers occurrence (Assistance Listing references); never numeric. |
| `eligibility_labels_json` | `VARCHAR` | Position-aligned labels from the pinned RefSpec code list; null means the raw code is absent from that retained vocabulary. |
| `funding_category_labels_json` | `VARCHAR` | Position-aligned pinned RefSpec category labels; unknown raw codes keep a null label. |
| `post_date` | `DATE` | Parsed PostDate when it is a valid MMDDYYYY date; null otherwise. Literal text and status remain; no lifecycle status is inferred. |
| `close_date` | `DATE` | Parsed CloseDate when it is a valid MMDDYYYY date; null otherwise. Literal text and status remain; no lifecycle status is inferred. |
| `last_updated_date` | `DATE` | Parsed LastUpdatedDate when it is a valid MMDDYYYY date; null otherwise. Literal text and status remain; no lifecycle status is inferred. |
| `archive_date` | `DATE` | Parsed ArchiveDate when it is a valid MMDDYYYY date; null otherwise. Literal text and status remain; no lifecycle status is inferred. |
| `estimated_synopsis_post_date` | `DATE` | Parsed EstimatedSynopsisPostDate when it is a valid MMDDYYYY date; null otherwise. Literal text and status remain; no lifecycle status is inferred. |
| `estimated_synopsis_close_date` | `DATE` | Parsed EstimatedSynopsisCloseDate when it is a valid MMDDYYYY date; null otherwise. Literal text and status remain; no lifecycle status is inferred. |
| `estimated_award_date` | `DATE` | Parsed EstimatedAwardDate when it is a valid MMDDYYYY date; null otherwise. Literal text and status remain; no lifecycle status is inferred. |
| `estimated_project_start_date` | `DATE` | Parsed EstimatedProjectStartDate when it is a valid MMDDYYYY date; null otherwise. Literal text and status remain; no lifecycle status is inferred. |
| `award_ceiling` | `DECIMAL(38,2)` | Exact AwardCeiling decimal when representable as DECIMAL(38,2); no rounding or assumed unit. Original text and missing/unknown status remain. |
| `award_floor` | `DECIMAL(38,2)` | Exact AwardFloor decimal when representable as DECIMAL(38,2); no rounding or assumed unit. Original text and missing/unknown status remain. |
| `estimated_total_program_funding` | `DECIMAL(38,2)` | Exact EstimatedTotalProgramFunding decimal when representable as DECIMAL(38,2); no rounding or assumed unit. Original text and missing/unknown status remain. |
| `amount_unit` | `VARCHAR` | Null: the selected XML controls do not establish a currency/unit for every amount. |
| `value_statuses_json` | `VARCHAR` | Per-date/amount status: value, missing, blank, unparsed, publisher_none, or unrepresentable. Read raw_fields_json for exact text. |
| `source_record_id` | `VARCHAR` | Native kind and opportunity identity in the admitted SpicyDocs source release. |
| `source_release_logical_id` | `VARCHAR` | Logical identity of the admitted SpicyDocs release. |
| `source_release_digest` | `VARCHAR` | Exact source release digest; distinguishes successive snapshots and same-date revisions. |
| `source_ordinal` | `BIGINT` | Zero-based record position in the original XML; source reader order may differ. |
| `source_locator_json` | `VARCHAR` | Original archive URL/digest, capture time, member name/digest and XML record path. |
| `raw_fields_json` | `VARCHAR` | Every direct XML field occurrence in original order with expanded tag, exact decoded text, attributes and source XPath; unknown fields remain. |
| `vocabulary_source_sha256` | `VARCHAR` | Digest of the official Grants.gov code page parsed by the pinned RefSpec implementation. |
